Tourists, Visitors, CARICOM Nationals & eVISA Holders

notices: If you are a foreign national visiting St. Kitts and Nevis, you need to apply for an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA)
Citizens and residents of St. Kitts and Nevis, OECS citizens must submit the Immigration and Customs ED Form.
Choose this option if you are a citizen or resident of St. Kitts and Nevis or a national of Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, St. Lucia or St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

steps.name: How to Apply
notices: All visitors including infants and children who intend to travel to the Federation of St. Kitts and Nevis must have an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before the start of their journey.
A valid passport for at least six (6) months after your planned date of arrival into St. Kitts and Nevis, with at least one blank page
A payment method - you can use Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Apple Pay or Google Pay

steps.name: Declaration of Consent

fields.label: I have read and agreed to the above.
Opt-in to enter giveaways, and receive special offers and exciting updates for your trip from third parties.

notices: that the possession of an approved eTA is not the final authority to enter the Federation of St. Kitts and Nevis. Admissibility is determined at the point of entry upon travellers' arrival.
providing false or incomplete information may result in the rejection of your travel authorisation.
that if this application is made by an agent or automated system of a third party website, it will be automatically denied.

steps.name: Individual or group
notices: If you are a family or a group of up to 6 people, you can save time by applying as a group.

steps.name: Country of Residence
notices: Please select your country of residence. This is the country where you live and pay taxes.

steps.name: Passport Information
notices: Provide a clear image of your passport's biographic page.
